scenarios.name: Restore a hidden panel in the undocked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top with Modify visible
the user hides Modify through Show Panels
the floating ribbon does not show the Modify group
the user opens Show Panels on the floating ribbon
the Modify group appears between Create and Explore in the floating ribbon
the user docks the floating ribbon at the left
the Modify group is visible in the side-docked ribbon
